I have implemented the three requested features from the product design matching the reference screenshots [claim-damage-diagram.png](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/design-ref/claim-damage-diagram.png) and [capture-recapture-round.png](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/design-ref/capture-recapture-round.png).

### Summary of Changes

1. **Damage Parts Seen vs. Listed by Claimant:**
   - Extended `damage` and `wide` schemas in [witnessed/schemas.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/witnessed/schemas.py) with `parts_seen: list[str]` using the claimant's exact 14-part vocabulary (`VALID_PARTS`).
   - Updated Gemini prompts and `FakeProvider` default in [witnessed/providers.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/witnessed/providers.py), plus the "Wrong side" seed in [app/seed.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/seed.py).
   - Added `parts_match` check in [witnessed/checks.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/witnessed/checks.py) (`green` if overlapping; `amber` with `"The photos show {seen}, but the claim lists {listed}."` if no overlap; `unchecked` if either side is empty).
   - Rendered the top-down car diagram (~200px SVG on a blueprint grid with FRONT/Driver's/Passenger labels, amber fills for seen parts, red dashed outlines for claimant-only parts, summary line, and legend) in the Review card's Damage group in [app/templates/console_claim.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_claim.html).

2. **Recapture Request & Round 2 Flow:**
   - On recapture request (`POST /console/claims/{id}/recapture`), the adjuster selects one or more slots (`plate`, `vin`, `damage`, `wide`) with an optional reason. The session reopens exclusively for those slots with status `recapture_requested` in [app/main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py).
   - Implemented the claimant round-2 page in [app/templates/capture.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/capture.html) matching [design-ref/capture-recapture-round.png](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/design-ref/capture-recapture-round.png): amber banner, progress counter/bar, requested slot cards tagged "Requested again" with live camera capture, "Kept as you sent them" thumbnail strip, read-only answers cards, and the "Send the new photo(s)" action button.
   - Restriced uploads during recapture in [app/main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py) to reject unrequested slots with HTTP 400.
   - On send, slot photos are updated, checks re-run, and a version 2 package (`version: 2`) with `previous_signature` is sealed and saved. The claim returns to `ready_for_review`, the console displays "Round 2", and package downloads serve version 2.

3. **Decisions, Notes & Timeline:**
   - Added the "Your decision" card in [app/templates/console_claim.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_claim.html): primary "Approve" button, 2×2 button grid ("Edit and approve", "Request recapture", "Refer to SIU" in red, "Field inspection"), inline edit-and-approve note panel, inline recapture slot picker, and decision log. No reject button.
   - Added the "Notes" card in [app/templates/console_claim.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_claim.html) backed by `claim_notes` in [app/db.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/db.py) and endpoint `POST /console/claims/{id}/notes`.
   - Appended all 11 lifecycle events to `claim_events` in [app/db.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/db.py) in chronological sequence (`claim_created`, `link_opened`, `answers_saved`, `photo_taken`, `submitted`, `sealed`, `recapture_requested`, `round_2_sent`, `decision`, `note`, `finding_label`).
   - Added the "More actions" card with a toggleable vertical timeline drawer in [app/templates/console_claim.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_claim.html).
   - Styled all components in [app/static/style.css](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/static/style.css).

4. **Testing:**
   - Added comprehensive tests in [tests/test_new_features.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/tests/test_new_features.py) covering `parts_match` (overlap, no overlap, empty), end-to-end recapture round, decisions (`field_inspection`, `edit_and_approve`, UI verification), notes persistence/display, and chronological timeline event ordering.
   - Updated existing assertions in [tests/test_checks.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/tests/test_checks.py) and [tests/test_seed.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/tests/test_seed.py).
